2. What does the term catalyst refer?
i) Can either increase or decrease the rate of a chemical reaction.
ii) Increase the speed of a chemical reaction.
iii) Decreases the speed of a chemical reaction.
iv) Increases the concentration of reactants.
Ans:- i) Can either increase or decrease the rate of a chemical reaction.

Section ‘B’
Very short answer type questions.
1. What is meant by combination reaction?
Ans:- A combination reaction (also known as a synthesis reaction) is a type of chemical reaction in which two or more
reactants—which can be elements or compounds—combine to form a single new substance.
2. Write the reaction between concentration of reactants and the rate of chemical reaction.
Ans:- The rate of a chemical reaction increases with an increase in the concentration of reactants because a higher
concentration means more reacting particles per unit volume, which leads to more frequent and effective collisions.
Therefore, as the concentration of reactants increases, the number of successful collisions increases, and the rate of reaction
becomes faster.
3. Calcium + Sulphuric acid → Calcium Sulphate + Hydrogen. Mention its type of chemical reaction.
Ans:- This is a single displacement (replacement) reaction because calcium, being more reactive, displaces hydrogen from
sulphuric acid to form calcium sulphate and hydrogen gas.
4. Define positive catalyst.
Ans:- A positive catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent
chemical change at the end of the reaction.
5. What is neutralization reaction?
Ans:- A neutralization reaction is a chemical reaction in which an acid reacts with a base to form salt and water, thereby
neutralizing the acidic and basic properties of the reactants.
6. Define decomposition reaction?
Ans:- A decomposition reaction is a chemical reaction in which a single compound breaks down into two or more simpler
substances when energy such as heat, light, or electricity is supplied.
7. What is the rate of chemical reaction?
Ans:- The rate of a chemical reaction is defined as the change in concentration of reactants or products per unit time during
the course of a chemical reaction.
8. Name the compound formed by the chemical reaction between oxygen and Carbon?
Ans:-The compound formed by the chemical reaction between Oxygen and Carbon is Carbon dioxide.
